episodes.synopsis: With the Demon Lord defeated, Keyaru’s revenge begins. The first step is to rewind time. Followed by planning…
episodes.title: The Healer Starts Over!

episodes.synopsis: Flare has a dark side that Keyaru originally didn’t see until it was too late. Forgiveness isn’t something that he’s interested in now. So, he waits…
episodes.title: The Healer Ruins Princess Flare!

episodes.synopsis: One does not forget the past, even if it hasn’t happened yet. Many people remain unpunished. Getting to them may require help, though.
episodes.title: The Healer Buys a Slave!

episodes.synopsis: How far will Setsuna go for revenge? Keyarga is curious to know.
episodes.title: The Healer Acquires Setsuna!

episodes.synopsis: Keyarga’s actions have not gone unnoticed. He used the Krylet sword technique against Gioral soldiers. And one woman will not let the insult stand.
episodes.title: The Healer Finds a New Toy!

episodes.synopsis: The cost of revenge is steep. Especially when innocents pay the price.
episodes.title: The Healer Sheds Blood and Tears!

episodes.synopsis: They expected the Hero of Recovery. They planned on him being heroic. Unfortunately for them, Keyarga isn’t a hero.
episodes.title: The Healer Executes Justice!

episodes.synopsis: Keyarga knows this woman. She will become the Demon Lord and the enemy of all humankind. So, what is she doing in a city where humans and demonic beings coexist?
episodes.title: The Healer Meets the Demon Lord!

episodes.synopsis: Keyarga, Freia and Setsuna will protect Eve until she becomes the Demon Lord. But that protection comes at a price: The Philosopher’s Stone.
episodes.title: The Healer Takes Revenge for a Meal!

episodes.synopsis: How does one catch a predator? Keyarga turns himself into the perfect bait.
episodes.title: The Healer Becomes a Single, Lovely Flower!

episodes.synopsis: Keara reads Blade’s memories and learns Norn plans to attack Branica in three days and with his new weapon, he hopes to take revenge.
episodes.title: The Healer is Troubled by Norn’s Brutality!

episodes.synopsis: An unexpected development catches Norn off guard. She needs another plan, but that assumes she can first survive Keyarga’s wrath.
episodes.title: The Healer Starts a New Journey!
